item.title: Dad's Daily Digest — 2026-02-28
item.description:
# This Week's Episode Summary
This episode covers three major stories shaping markets and portfolios: the U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran that killed Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei, creating a leadership vacuum with immediate implications for oil prices and the Strait of Hormuz chokepoint; Berkshire Hathaway's first earnings report under new CEO Gregory Abel, marked by a tonal shift from Buffett's famous folksy style and a decline driven by insurance weakness; and a sharp takedown of media panic around private markets, which argues investors should parse distinct stories about private credit rather than treating them as one unified crisis.
